description: Get the current Swiss avalanche danger bulletin from SLF (WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research). Returns current bulletin URLs, danger level descriptions, and links to the interactive map. The bulletin is published daily at ~08:00 and updated at ~17:00 Swiss time (October–May).

language.description: Language for bulletin links: de (German), en (English), fr (French), it (Italian). Default: en

region.description: Optional region ID (e.g. CH-9 for Central Graubünden) or region name. Use list_avalanche_regions to see all options. If omitted, returns national overview.

name: get_avalanche_bulletin
